title: 第8章 师父，我走了
slug: 九阳剑圣全本免费-九阳剑圣最新章节列表
content_zh:
“太惊人了，太惊人了！当年我第二层洗髓伐脉足足花了四天四夜，而你仅仅只有两个多时辰，所耗费的玄力更是连我当时的十分之一都不到，太惊人了！”
“孩子，我现在面临一个选择，是继续为你洗脉，还是就此停止？”
“继续洗脉？很可能我的玄力已经不够了，若洗髓中途玄力不济那后果不堪设想，而且你的身体也仿佛到了极限。若停止洗脉，我又残留了不少玄力，实在太浪费了，我实在不甘心，若能为你洗到第三层等于你少奋斗几年，你就可以早几年成为阴阳宗的掌门，我实在不甘心！”
“我到底是继续？还是停止？”
当然，阳顶天已经完全无法给他回答了，因为他连手指头都无法动弹一下，更别说说话了，甚至连眼神都无法流露。
“上天让你出现在我的面前，就是为了创造奇迹，我赌了，我拼了，我们继续，就算万一失败反噬了，我也……”
最后，在充满决绝的口气中，东方涅灭开始了对阳顶天的第三次洗髓伐脉。
第二次，阳顶天的痛苦就已经到了极限，东方涅灭也苍老了十几岁，但是依旧进行了第三次。
第三次，阳顶天已经完全感觉不到自己身体的存在了，这是一个极度危险的信号，他感觉不到自己的手脚，感觉不到自己的四肢，甚至感觉不到自己的面孔。没有了视觉，听觉，就仿佛仅有一丝神识漂浮在熊熊烈火和极酷寒冰之间。
东方涅灭也完全一肉眼能够看得见的速度变得衰老，皮肤一层一层的褶皱，身体一层一层地消瘦。原本的头发虽然已经白了，但终究还是带着光泽，此时如同脱水的草一般开始飞快干枯。
一个小时，两个小时，三个小时……
天黑了，然后天又再次大亮！
整整二十多个小时过去了，第三次的洗髓伐脉仍旧在继续。再看东方涅灭，已经枯廋得如同干尸一般，比起最开始的他还要苍老灰白，已经完全油尽灯枯。阳顶天刚刚遇到他的时候，头发虽然如同枯草一般，但好歹还是茂盛的。但此时，他灰白干枯的头发也一根一根地断裂粉碎，干瘦的头皮上仅仅只是寥寥无几的几根头发。
而身上的那件袍子，此时已经成为一丝一缕。
至于阳顶天，一开始身体还流出黑色的杂质，但是到后来渗出来的东西已经渗着血色，最后全身的皮肤血脉索性如同网状一般裂开，鲜血渗出，使得阳顶天这个人浑身都血肉模糊。
此时，东方涅灭的玄力已经逼到阳顶天的头顶，第三次洗髓伐脉已经完成了99%，但是阳顶天的生命已经垂危，仿佛只要再有一两力气压上就会直接血脉爆裂而死。
而最最可怕的是，东方涅灭体内气海已经空空如也，浑身再也没有一丝玄力了。
“难道真的要功败垂成？”东方涅灭悲绝问天，原本他还保留一丝力量以防万一保护阳顶天的生命。但是洗髓伐脉到了最后玄力不足，所以他将最后储备的力量也用了。但就算这样，依旧无法完成最后的洗脉，进度停留在最后的1%不到，此时停止阳顶天已经必死无疑。
“本来还想要一次最后的告别，但是现在没有了。”东方涅灭缓缓道。
““知道我为何会被困在这万里冰川之下。”

“当你足够强大的时候，去走完我没有走完的道路，彻底挑战这个世界的秩序，看看所谓的神究竟存不存在？”
“““永别了……”
东方涅灭一阵狂吼！
“轰……”一股烈焰猛地从他体内迸发而出，他的整个身体熊熊燃烧。
“轰……”深深的寒冰洞穴猛地爆炸，蓝色的光芒猛地迸现，如同一枚无比巨大的导弹在洞穴中爆炸。
蓝色的光芒横扫洞**的一切，晶莹剔透的寒冰洞穴猛地龟裂。阳顶天耗费了一年制作出来的一万多只寒冰台阶瞬间爆开碎裂。

content_en:
"It's amazing, it's amazing! Back then, it took me four days and four nights to cleanse my marrow and cut my veins at the second level, but you only had more than two hours, and the profound energy you expended was less than one-tenth of what I did back then. It's amazing!"
"My child, I am now faced with a choice. Should I continue cleaning your pulse, or should I stop here?"
"Continue to cleanse the veins? It is very likely that my profound strength is not enough. If my profound strength fails during the cleansing of the marrow, the consequences will be disastrous, and your body seems to have reached its limit. If I stop cleaning the veins, I will have a lot of profound strength left, which is really a waste. I am really not willing to accept it. If I can wash you to the third level, you will save a few years of hard work, and you can become the head of the Yin Yang Sect a few years earlier. I am really not willing to accept it!"
"Should I continue? Or should I stop?"
Of course, Yang Dingtian was completely unable to answer him, because he couldn't even move his fingers, let alone speak, or even show his eyes.
"God made you appear in front of me just to create a miracle. I bet, I fought hard, let's continue. Even if failure backfires, I will..."
Finally, in a tone full of determination, Dongfang Nirvana began the third marrow cleansing and cutting of Yang Dingtian.
The second time, Yang Dingtian's pain had reached the limit, and Dongfang Nirvana was more than ten years older, but he still went on for the third time.
For the third time, Yang Dingtian couldn't feel the existence of his body at all. This was an extremely dangerous signal. He couldn't feel his hands and feet, couldn't feel his limbs, and couldn't even feel his face. Without vision and hearing, it was as if there was only a trace of consciousness floating between the blazing fire and the extremely cold ice.
Dongfang Nirvana is also aging at a speed that can be seen by the naked eye. His skin is wrinkled layer by layer, and his body is losing weight layer by layer. Although the original hair was already white, it still had a luster after all. At this time, it began to dry up quickly like dehydrated grass.
One hour, two hours, three hours...
It gets dark, and then it gets bright again!
More than twenty hours have passed, and the third marrow cleansing and pulse cutting are still going on. Looking at Dongfang Nirvana again, he was as withered as a mummy. He was older and grayer than he was at the beginning, and he was completely exhausted. When Yang Dingtian first met him, although his hair was like dry grass, it was still lush. But at this time, his gray and dry hair was broken and shattered one by one, and there were only a few hairs on his thin scalp.
And the robe on her body has now become a strand.
As for Yang Dingtian, black impurities were oozing out of his body at first, but later the things that oozed out were already oozing with blood. Finally, the skin and blood vessels all over his body simply cracked like a mesh, and blood seeped out, making Yang Dingtian's whole body covered in blood.
At this time, Dongfang Nirvana's mysterious power had reached Yang Dingtian's head, and 99% of the third marrow cleansing and vein cutting had been completed. However, Yang Dingtian's life was already in danger, as if his blood veins would burst and die if he exerted even more pressure.
And the most terrifying thing is that the sea of ​​qi in Dongfang Nirvana's body is completely empty, and there is no trace of profound energy in his body.
"Is it really going to fail?" Dongfang Nirvana Bei Jue Wentian, originally he still retained a bit of strength to protect Yang Dingtian's life just in case. However, in the end, his profound strength was insufficient after purifying the marrow and cutting down the veins, so he used the last remaining strength. But even so, the final pulse cleaning still cannot be completed, and the progress is still less than the last 1%. If Yang Dingtian stops at this time, he will definitely die.
"I originally wanted to say a final farewell, but now I don't have it." Dongfang Nirvana said slowly.
""I know why I am trapped under this thousand-mile glacier. "
"When you are strong enough, go and complete the path that I have not completed, completely challenge the order of this world, and seeDoes the so-called God exist? "
""Farewell..."
Dongfang Nirvana roared wildly!
"Boom..." A burst of flames burst out from his body, and his entire body burned.
"Boom..." The deep ice cave exploded suddenly, and blue light suddenly burst out, like an extremely huge missile exploding in the cave.
Blue light swept across everything in the cave, and the crystal clear ice cave suddenly cracked. The more than 10,000 ice steps that Yang Dingtian spent a year making exploded and shattered instantly.
